downloads: Both Unsloth UD-IQ1_S GGUFs complete (144.4 GiB) under gguf/, pinned by model-configs/*.gguf.lock.json. MLX 4-bit partials retained but superseded for the two Flash profiles.
implemented: DiffusionGemma block-diffusion generation (vendored model + entropy-bound sampler in diffusion_engine.py)
Pinned IQ1 GGUF downloader (setup_gguf.py) with revision locks
MLX device decoders for IQ1_S, IQ1_M, IQ2_XXS, IQ3_XXS, IQ4_NL and MXFP4, bit-exact against the gguf reference
Single-dispatch Metal dequant kernels for the five expert formats (iq_metal.py)
Fused gate/up expert banks: two gathers per selection instead of three
deepseek4 and qwen4exp GGUF-to-MLX loaders with streaming routed experts over an undecoded hot set
Row-streamed GGUF n-gram (PLE) table so Qwen's 26.8 GiB table is never decoded into memory
Gemma 4 text profile (26B-A4B) served through the pinned mlx_lm gemma4_text implementation
Context-scaling probe measuring prefill and decode against prompt length
Tracked reference bibliography of the optimization methods used or evaluated (docs/references.md)

Vision serving for multimodal profiles: vision_engine.py loads the full VLM (text + vision tower) from the vendored flash_vlm Gemma 4 with mlx_lm mixed-precision quantization, input_parts.extract_vision_messages decodes image_url parts (base64/data-URL/http) to PIL images, and serve.py install_vision() routes gemma4-26b-a4b and gemma4-31b single-request through the VLM

Vision for the qwen3_5 family: vision_engine is family-aware (gemma4 and qwen3_5), loading the vendored flash_vlm Qwen3-VL VLM (pixel_values + image_grid_thw) and expanding each <|image_pad|> to prod(grid_thw)/merge_size**2 tokens; qwen3.8-27b serves images

Vision path renders agentic requests like the text path: request tools and profile chat_template_args are passed to the chat template, and function.arguments is normalised from the OpenAI wire format JSON string to a mapping (Qwen template iterates tool_call.arguments|items, which raised "Can only get item pairs from a mapping")
The vision serve path completes the telemetry lifecycle (preparing -> token -> finish) instead of replacing the instrumented _serve_single and leaving requests stuck queued with 0 tok/s
validated: 68 regression tests pass; every profile resolves (18 with weights on disk)
15 of 16 downloaded profiles serve with default flags end to end, answering a factual question; the two that do not are the partially downloaded Flash profiles, which refuse with an explicit message
MTP speculation returns byte-identical text to greedy decoding and does not corrupt multi-byte characters (CJK and emoji verified), with finish_reason reported and no template markers in replies

the serving flags are verified against the loaded model's caches: sliding-window, MLA and recurrent-only families are declared unquantized, and a wrong declaration fails at startup rather than mid-request

context extension is verified per profile by serving a request afterwards: minicpm5/smollm3/llama/gpt-oss to 262,144, glm-4.7-flash to 405,504, nemotron to 524,288; Qwen3.5-family, Muse Glimmer and Gemma 4 hang and are restored
Spark2.5 runs from a vendored port of its own modelling code: 55.3 tok/s, 1,048,576 native context, pinned by a test that requires incremental decoding to equal one full forward
the architecture audit found Muse Glimmer matching, MiniCPM5 and GPT-OSS matching apart from YaRN's ignored truncate flag, and GLM-4.7-Flash differing in MLA norm epsilon and router precision
an adversarial review's four MTP defects (per-token decoding, unfiltered end-of-turn token, cache keyed by emitted rather than covered tokens, unflushed normaliser) are fixed and verified

vision end-to-end: colour, OCR, and counting answered correctly on gemma4-26b-a4b (over HTTP, streaming and not, plus text-only unchanged) and on gemma4-31b (in-process); test_vision.py 6 tests OK; check_vision.py writes gemma4-26b-a4b-vision-check.json (3/3)
qwen3.8-27b vision end-to-end over HTTP on port 8080 (colour, OCR, counting, streaming, text-only unchanged; check_vision.py 3/3, qwen3.8-27b-vision-check.json)

the tool_calls 404 is fixed and verified over HTTP: tool history (string arguments) answers, a declared tool yields a proper tool_call with finish_reason tool_calls, and a combined image + tool-history + tools request answers; test_vision.py 12 tests OK, suite 119 OK
telemetry on the vision profile verified live: tokens_per_second 11.2-11.4 and no stuck request rows after text and image requests
pending: the two Flash profiles need their weights downloaded before they can serve
Qwen3.5-family, Muse Glimmer and Gemma 4 cannot extend context with YaRN in the pinned runtime; they also answer worse at long range than the extended models
GLM-4.7-Flash and Muse Glimmer are served with vendor-acknowledged precision differences in the pinned runtime (MLA norm epsilon, router matmul precision)
prompt-prefix reuse remains limited to exact repeats and strict extensions, because a chat turn is not a token prefix of its own next turn
inference_backend: MLX only; no llama.cpp inference backend installed.
